name: Nitrium
description: A performance mod for 1.21.11 with an adaptive quality governor, entity render culling, and server-side tick/worldgen/lighting optimizations. Complements Sodium, Iris and Lithium.

suggests.iris: Shader packs — Nitrium's governor and culling complement Iris
suggests.sodium: Client rendering — Nitrium GPU culling and streaming complement Sodium
suggests.lithium: Server optimizations — Nitrium defers overlapping tick/light/hopper patches
suggests.starlight: Lighting — Nitrium defers its lighting engine when Starlight is present
suggests.c2me: Chunk generation — Nitrium defers worldgen task graph when C2ME is present
suggests.clumps: XP merging — Nitrium defers item/XP pooling when Clumps is present
suggests.krypton: Networking — Nitrium defers packet pipeline when Krypton is present
suggests.ferritecore: Memory — Nitrium defers SoA layout when FerriteCore is present
suggests.alternate-current: Redstone — Nitrium defers topological wire solver when present
